title: Willow
body:
Description

The Willow Tree is located in the Acid Wastes This tree is characterized by its long light green leaves and thin olive-green branches.

  • Once cut down, the raw willow log sells for $3 per stud.
  • Using the saw or a sander, sanded willow wood sells for $20 per stud.
  • Using a planker, planked willow wood sells for $25 per stud.
  • Not to be confused with the Weeping willow.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Willow to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • Prior to the Oaklands Map update, the Willow tree used to spawn across the entire map. However, it now only spawns in the Acid Wastes and Flowering Meadows.
